InteractiveMap.title: Interactive Map for Egyptian Destinations
InteractiveMap.subtitle: Explore famous tourist and archaeological landmarks via high-resolution satellite imagery with AI analysis.

pyramids.name: Giza Pyramids
pyramids.description: One of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World and a testament to ancient Egyptian engineering genius.

luxor_karnak.name: Karnak Temple
luxor_karnak.description: A stunning pharaonic temple complex considered the largest house of worship in the ancient world.

abu_simbel.name: Abu Simbel Temples
abu_simbel.location: South of Aswan near the Sudanese border
abu_simbel.description: Two architectural masterpieces of King Ramses II and Queen Nefertari carved directly into the mountain.

siwa.name: Siwa Oasis & Salt Lakes
siwa.location: Western Desert, near the Libyan border
siwa.description: A magical oasis featuring natural water springs and therapeutic crystal salt lakes.

dahab_bluehole.name: Blue Hole
dahab_bluehole.description: One of the world's most famous diving spots featuring stunning coral reefs and turquoise depths.

philae.name: Philae Temple
philae.description: The enchanting island sanctuary dedicated to the goddess Isis amidst the waters of the Nile.

nmec.name: National Museum of Egyptian Civilization
nmec.description: Houses the royal mummies and exclusive collections expressing Egypt's history across the ages.

khan_el_khalili.name: Khan el-Khalili & Al-Muizz
khan_el_khalili.description: The beating heart of historic Islamic Cairo, filled with traditional crafts and heritage cafes.

ras_mohamed.name: Ras Mohamed National Park
ras_mohamed.location: Confluence of Gulf of Aqaba and Suez
ras_mohamed.description: Egypt's first national park, renowned for coral reefs and breathtaking biodiversity.

white_desert.name: White Desert
white_desert.era: Geological formations over thousands of years
white_desert.description: Unique white chalk rock formations making you feel as if you are walking on the moon.

st_catherine.name: Saint Catherine's Monastery
st_catherine.location: Saint Catherine City, below Mount Sinai
st_catherine.description: The oldest continuously inhabited monastery in the world, housing rare manuscripts and Byzantine icons.

vally_of_kings.name: Valley of the Kings
vally_of_kings.description: Tombs of pharaonic kings, most notably the tombs of Tutankhamun and Hatshepsut.

qaitbay.name: Citadel of Qaitbay
qaitbay.description: A robust defensive fortress built on the Mediterranean coast on the site of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria.

alex_library.name: Bibliotheca Alexandrina
alex_library.description: A modern beacon of culture and science shaped like a sun disc rising from the sea.

giftun_island.name: Giftun Island (Protected)
giftun_island.description: Pristine islands featuring stunning white sands and crystal turquoise waters.

dendera.name: Dendera Temple
dendera.location: Dendera City, West of the Nile
dendera.description: One of the best-preserved temples in Egypt with exquisite details, colors, and astronomical secrets.

saqqara.name: Pyramid of Djoser (Step Pyramid)
saqqara.description: History's first massive stone building and the precursor to pyramid construction.

kom_ombo.name: Kom Ombo Temple
kom_ombo.description: A unique double temple on the banks of the Nile dedicated to the deities Sobek and Horus.

wadi_el_hitan.name: Wadi El Hitan (Whale Valley)
wadi_el_hitan.location: Wadi El Rayan Protected Area, Fayoum
wadi_el_hitan.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site containing rare fossils of early extinct primitive whales.

marsa_alam.name: Hankorab Beach (The Meteor)
marsa_alam.location: South of Marsa Alam, Wadi El Gemal National Park
marsa_alam.description: Enchanting beaches and a natural lagoon resembling the Maldives in purity and marine life.

luxorAswan.title: Luxor & Aswan - Capital of History
luxorAswan.description: An open-air museum holding a third of the world's monuments, offering a magical Nile cruise between eternal pharaonic temples and Nubian charm.
highlights: Valley of the Kings and Queens

redSea.title: Red Sea & Hurghada
redSea.description: Pristine turquoise waters and unique coral reefs, featuring top diving spots and luxury marine sports.
redSea.bestTime: Best time: Year-round (May - September for summer)

sinai.title: South Sinai, Dahab & Sharm El Sheikh
sinai.description: The magic of majestic Sinai mountains combined with the serene beaches of Dahab and international resorts of Sharm El Sheikh.

siwa.title: Siwa Oasis & Western Desert
siwa.description: The paradise of the Western Desert, natural sulfur springs, and sprawling palm trees amidst golden sands.

alex.title: Alexandria & North Coast
alex.description: The bride of the Mediterranean, blending Greco-Roman historical elegance with stunning coastal beaches.
